title: Westlake Corporation Form 8-K — Settlement of PVC Pipe Antitrust Litigation
summary: Westlake Corporation filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026 disclosing a settlement agreement with direct purchaser plaintiffs (DPPs) in the PVC Pipe Antitrust Litigation for $67 million, subject to court approval. The settlement covers allegations that PVC pipe manufacturers conspired with each other and industry publication OPIS to fix, raise, and stabilize PVC pipe and fittings prices in the United States. Indirect purchaser claims remain pending.
key_points: Westlake agreed to pay $67 million to settle with DPPs in the PVC Pipe Antitrust Litigation
The DPPs filed a motion for preliminary approval of the Settlement Agreement on April 13, 2026
Ten putative class action lawsuits were filed in Illinois between August 2024 and June 2025
Allegations include conspiracy to fix prices of PVC pipe and fittings with industry publication OPIS
Indirect purchaser plaintiffs' claims remain pending and are not covered by this settlement
Settlement is conditional on preliminary and final court approval
